purpose: Test whether adding regime, risk-adjusted trend, volume/flow confirmation and ATR exits improves the previously weak dual-horizon edge.

researchRules.btcRegime: BTC close above EMA200 and 30d momentum positive
researchRules.flowProxy: taker-buy quote volume ratio on closed 4h bars
researchRules.relativeVolume: current closed 4h quote volume / trailing 20-bar mean

notes: Thresholds frozen before result. Binance kline taker-buy volume is an exchange-local proxy, not the world-order-flow measure used in the cited academic paper. Passing this gate permits forward paper testing only.
